rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by the ND Board of Nursing, an accredited college or university, a health care regulatory board, or a professional organization nationally accredited to approve CE; BLS/CPR and in-house orientation do not count
rules.new_licensee_rule: Nurses first licensed by examination need no CE before the first renewal; nurses licensed by endorsement must attest to 12 hours at their first renewal.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; excess hours do not carry to the next period.
rules.audit_note: Random audit via the board's Nurse Portal; keep original certificates for at least two renewal cycles. CE finished after December 31 of the renewal year costs $50 per contact hour.
rules.notes: Renewal also requires 400 hours of nursing practice in the last 4 years (waived after a recent refresher course or graduation). Licenses expire December 31; no specific CE topics required.
rules.rule_quote: In order to renew a license a licensee must demonstrate successful completion of 12 contact hours of continuing education (CE) within the preceding two years.
